## CELL FACTS

Cell 土_食神 (Earth carrying The Artisan). Persona The Artisan (食神). Definition line: "Output that flows from you, giving that feels like being". Keyword Flow, charge gentle, poles catalyst Grace / friction Coasting. Family function: Expression. Cost dimension: giving that feels like being; worth tangled with what is made. Arena: craft, hands, the table, warmth of making, fed and feeding. Classical portrait: ease and appetite; output that flows without assertion; generous, content, prone to drift and indulgence. Ruled domains: Expression, Enjoyment, Children. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 伤官.
Element arena: Earth (ground, soil, load, field, bedrock, harvest). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Fire. structural_interaction seed: "Fire generating Earth same-polarity — warmth as natural source of stable deposits".
- k2_overview: "Your Earth moves as the Artisan: ground that sets a table. Nourishment is your native act, the meal made, the household provisioned, the comfort arranged before anyone asked. You produce abundance the way fields do, reliably and without spectacle. People leave your care fed in ways they cannot fully name."
- k2_functional: "You express through provision more than proclamation. The full pantry is your love letter."
- adj_chips: {"friction":["Coasting","Sluggish","Pampered"],"catalyst":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Expression":"Your expression is the kept table: cooking, homemaking, the craft of comfort itself. It looks humble and it is foundational. Whole families run on exactly what you make daily.","Enjoyment":"You enjoy the settled pleasures: harvest meals, familiar comforts, the deep satisfaction of enough. Let abundance be enjoyed, not only stored. A pantry is for feasts as well as winters.","Children":"Children grow sturdy in your keeping: fed on time, held warmly, raised on rhythm. Yours is the house they bring their own children back to. Build it knowing that."}

  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 1: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 2: [REDACTED: the target row]
- Sibling cell 土_伤官 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Ground-breaking","Deadpan","Unconventional"],"friction":["Contrarian","Eye-rolling","Quake-prone"]}
- Sibling cell 土_伤官 catalyst row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Breaking new ground is how your expression works: the flat, settled, everyone-agrees surface is exactly where you start digging. Your best ideas arrive as polite earthquakes, reorganizing a topic people thought was finished. The field is never as settled as it looks, and you prove it."

Core element Fire, energy element Earth. Law: Fire feeds Earth (火生土: ash becomes soil). Relative to the core the energy is the fed, so Earth is this core's Expression. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Fire core that shows Earth on the catalyst pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The catalyst pole of Earth as the Expression is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: compliment. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 火_土's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.

value.text: Giving comes to you before the question does. Being useful is how you feel you belong, so you give first rather than wait to be asked. You lose nothing by waiting for the question, since a gift asked for is the one that gets kept.

value_b.text: Giving is your first language. You would rather hand over your help than wait to see whether it was wanted, since being needed is how you feel sure of your place. Keep some of it back for the people who ask.

value.text: Before the asking, you have usually already given. Because the gift comes ahead of the need, you never learn whether you were wanted or only useful. You pay in a closeness you never get to test until you let the asking come first.

value.text: Giving first is your way of saying you noticed. Each time you give instead of waiting to be needed, you take from the people closest to you the small pride of asking. Leave them the asking along with the giving.

value.text: What you make is made to last, slowly and on purpose. The making itself is the enjoyment, so you make things for the years rather than for the showing. You deserve the showing as much as the making, because work that stays unseen stays unused.

value_b.text: You make things slowly by choice, and the slow ones last. You enjoy the making more than the finishing, and your best things take years and hold for a long time. Let one out before it feels complete, since lasting work also needs its day.

value.text: Making things last is your idea of doing something right. Since the work is only right once it holds, you would rather be finished than first. Show one thing before it is done, or the chances that wanted you early close while you keep making.

value.text: Enough is a place you can live in. Being happy with what is here comes easier than wanting, so you enjoy what you have rather than chase what you lack. Let yourself want more sometimes, because enough has a way of shrinking.

value_b.text: You are happy with enough and mean it. Since more never felt like the point, you would rather enjoy a good day than work toward a better one. Keep one wish that enough does not cover, because contentment also needs somewhere to go.

value.text: Being happy with enough spares you a lot of chasing. Because contentment feels like wisdom, you settle for what is here instead of asking for more. Ask for more once a year, since the chance you never test closes as quietly as you settled.

value.text: At home, enough is the mood you set. Whenever enough comes early for you, you settle for the people in your care rather than push for them. Want more out loud for them, and the size of your enough becomes the size of their life.
